remarks: Ready to move into this hard to find, first floor, brick/vinyl, 2 bed, 2 bath with master suite, 1250 sq ft Condominium including kitchen with breakfast bar, pantry, living room with French door to private front porch, formal dining room, large storage room in basement and 1 car attached garage with opener.  Association has paid for new cement sidewalk, steps and vinyl railing and parking lot sealed with reserved parking spot.  Time to relax and allow the Association to take care of the exterior.  Monthly assessment payment includes basic cable, monthly cleaning of halls, water, sewer and all exterior maintenance.  All Appliances included as well as furnishings and window dressings.  New walk-in master shower, newer furnace with humidifier & central AC, bedroom windows and garage door opener.   Great location near transportation, shopping, restaurants, parks and everyday conveniences.  This one wont last.
